figure.title: Recovered actions by day
figure.description: Five zero-baseline bars show Hugging Face's recovered logged actions from July 9 through July 13, 2026. July 11 is the highest displayed day at 7,677 recovered actions.
figure.claim: Hugging Face reports five daily recovered-action counts for July 9 through July 13, 2026.
figure.doesNotProve: The chart does not show unique attacks, severity, intent, harm, complete activity, or causal relationships.
transformations: Do not normalize, smooth, aggregate, or infer values outside the reported interval.
Render one zero-baseline bar per date with the exact recovered-action value.
Sort the five source-reported UTC dates in ascending order.
figure.uncertainty: Hugging Face describes these as recovered actions. Unrecovered activity is unknown, and dates outside the interval are not zero values.
